verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents web, phone and mobile-app access plus the API Central developer platform, but nothing shows an official command-line interface for RUN. APIs and code samples are developer building blocks, not a CLI, so they earn no credit; an official CLI is a fair question for a SaaS payroll product, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
